name: make_a_stand_gives_your_creatures_plus_one_power_and_indestructible_only_the_ones_you_control_when_it_resolves
notes: Printed: 'Creatures you control get +1/+0 and gain indestructible until end of turn.' Seat 0 attacks with a 2/2 and keeps a 1/1 home; seat 1's 4/4 blocks the attacker and seat 1 has a second 2/2. With the blocker declared seat 0 casts Make a Stand ({2}{W}). Its attacker becomes 3/2 and deals 3 damage to the 4/4 (it survives with 3 marked); the 4/4 deals 4 damage to the attacker, which survives only because it is indestructible (4 damage marked on a toughness-2 creature). The home 1/1 gets +1/+0 too (2/1: all of the caster's creatures, not only attackers); toughness stays as printed (+0). Seat 1's creatures keep their power (4 and 2). A creature seat 0 puts onto the battlefield afterwards, in the same turn, was not on the battlefield when the spell resolved and gets nothing (CR 611.2c): the late 1/1 is still 1/1.
